reviews.text: Getting kind of pricey

They only care about dollars, not your precious pets.   It's all about the cash for this place.  Sad, as at one time it wasn't so bad, your at least not so damn obvious.   I was an Original customer from their original smaller location, and after many years, I will find a vet closer by that cares about my fur babies, and not just about getting cash from my pockets.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

PPAH North staff are very helpful and great with our 2 large dogs. They all explain everything so we can understand what’s happening. They are very caring towards our dogs and our dogs enjoy it when they are there. They are helpful in every way.
Terrible . Waited for hours after my scheduled appointment. And they are money grabbers. Better off going to pet co

I took my dog to this vet a week ago. The doctor noticed some redness in the ear and did not give any antibiotics said that the dog did not have an ear infection brought the dog back a week later with dehydration, and now the ears were very infected at this point they charge an extra office visit and an extra thousand dollars for dehydration. Had they given the medication from the beginning I wouldn’t have had to pay $1300 for this visit and they knew that, but by trying to make money off of me. Because they knew I had some sort of insurance. When I spoke to them about how I can’t afford this and that I was just there a week ago was spending $300 I said well at that point it wasn’t so bad if they had given an antibiotics that day I would’ve had to spend this much money and that’s terrible that a veterinarian who’s supposed to help dogs just care cares about the money in their pocket asked to speak to the manager about this so sorry so sorry we had to charge you an extra $1300. That’s all she kept saying $1300 for an ear visit. Think about that when you go to use this vet

Let’s start by saying, I’ve been going here for 7 years. My recent visits I’ve been going in for annual vaccine shots and every time they try and add extras to boost my bill (maybe cause ive been going once a year). They know you cherish your pets so they will make you feel bad for not doing a teeth cleaning (they estimated for 3k). Another experience. My dog was experiencing frequent UTIs. The solution was a surgery on her private area, my solution, I Realized she was drinking out of old water and probably building up bacteria. They always go the $$$ route instead of common solutions that might be the right thing but make them 0 dollars.  Do your research before choosing a vet cause this place does not care about your pet, only your pockets.

I’ve been bringing all of my large breed dogs to Pleasant Plains Animal Hospital for over 10 years, and they have always been amazing. The veterinarians are knowledgeable, caring, and truly take the time to make sure my dogs receive the best care possible. It’s important to me to have a team I can trust, and they’ve consistently been there for us through every stage of our dogs’ lives. The staff is also always kind, helpful, and welcoming. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate and reliable veterinary care.

Had dogs my whole life, lived all over and went to ALOT of different vets. This one is the best by a long shot. The staff actually cares and actually helps. Especially post surgery or post visit. They want to help and they go out of their way to follow up with you and check in. Very good after care for my puppy who had surgery. For that I’m locked in with them for life. 10/10 service. Thank you guys you are the best !

This veterinary clinic and its staff are top notch. They are very knowledgeable, friendly and compassionate. Dr Meleleo provides exceptional care and support. The whole staff including Dr Meleleo spends time explaining the care and answers all questions. They are very responsive to follow up questions and returns all calls. They are helpful over the phone and asks detailed questions in order to provide the right support. I have taken my pets to various clinics and this is one of the best. They treat your canine family members like their own.

This was my first visit to Pleasant Plains Animal Hospital and despite all the chaos with the covid, they were so organized.  I called to say I was there with my pet, they took all my information and told me they would come out to get Milo.   They came out and was so nice and patient with Milo and me.  The doctor then called me and spend quite a long time on the phone with me discussing his findings and my concerns.  They are professional, compassionate and very courteous to the pet parents.  I am very happy that I am now bringing my dog to them for his care.
5/8/26 Revised   I just left there after having to put my dog to sleep.  The compassion from every staff member was amazing.  God bless you and thank you for being so kind to Milo and my family.

Dr Meleleo is the best.  I have trusted him with my pets completely for the past  twelve years.  He has always taken the time to explain the situation, answer all my questions and is always approachable.  I know my dogs are well cared for here.  The entire staff is wonderful from the moment we walk in, until we leave.

My dog Mia uses PPAH, she loves everyone there and so do I. It starts as soon as you get in the door, the girls behind the desk are great. Then we go over to the tech that takes us into the room, the tech's are just as sweet and kind. The vets, no matter which one tended to Mia was kind & gentle. Mia was at PPAH on 2 separate occasions and they treated her like  queen, they sent me pictures of her at the end of the night and first thing in the morning. I highly recommend them for your pets they make you and your pet feel at ease.

Amazing with my cats and thorough with any issues my furry children are having. Pricing is also very fair 😊

They've been very helpful with my senior cats kidney disease and keeping it under control
Everyone is SO Knowledgeable and kind. Dr.Deaf is FANTASTIC in Every way sh listens and returns Calls every time.Thank you!🥰 …

Every staff member at Pleasant Plains from the wonderful staff at the front desk to the technicians to the nurses and the vets, All of them are just amazing! From start to finish, you will never be disappointed. My dog has got many issues going on. She is 15 years old and she had to be hospitalized there. I could not ask for a more amazing loving, kind and knowledgeable team that works around the clock to ensure the well-being of our pets. I highly recommend pleasant Plains to anyone with any type of pet. I have sat in their waiting room many times and watch many different types of animals come in the door and the amount of love that is shown to every animal and customer that walks in the door is amazing. Thank you all for the amazing job you do from the bottom of my heart. You are all amazing

This was the first time Dr. Elhadary took care of my dog, and the aftercare was absolutely outstanding, from start to finish. Dr. Meleleo handled the surgery perfectly, and my dog recovered beautifully. I completely trust this team, hands down the best veterinary hospital! Always thank you, thank you! 🐾
Always there when we need them. Kind, compassionate, and super accommodating.
Amazing staff

Have been here multiple times and I would not recommend this place to my worst enemy. They have no issue taking your time and your money. Every single visit I have waited over an hour past the appointment with not even so much as a sorry. While I understand you may be backed up its absolutely incredible to wait over an hour and a half for vaccinations.

I took my dog in for potentially having a blockage. They sedated him and did the ultrasound on him, except after doing the ultrasound they told us that "they wont have anyone able to review it until monday and that we should go to [insert another terrible vet service in tinton falls here]." Why even recommend the procedure if you have no one to interpret the data for 2 days. After readily and happily taking over $1000 they told us "just do it again with the previously mentioned er vet in NJ as they have better imaging equipment and will be able to interpret the data immediately".

Find a place who's passion is the animals and not the money to be made treating them.
thank you for taking such great care of scooby
They made a very sad day tolerable very nice people and very efficient

i’ve been bringing my pets here for a while, but i just had my kitten spayed here and they were so wonderful. a huge thank you to everyone here and for being so kind, thank you so much to everyone here for taking such great care of little kiki. i had work the next day when i had to pick her up and they were very accommodating to let me pick her up after i got out. honestly, everyone here is so accommodating. spays are so common, but i did have a cat pass away at a different vet afterwards and it stuck with me. i was so nervous for my little kiki, but they sent updates and informed me of everything going on. thank you so so so much! i would and will recommend this place to anyone that has a pet that they love!
Love the front desk ladies and Alyssa the vet tech was such a comfort during a stressful time. Truly appreciate the care and support!
I brought my cat in, I had a feeling she was dying, she had 2 masses..they made her go through a surgery she did not need, because she was dying.  She died 5 days later. I'm still traumatized by it
Place is a joke it’s a sales money pit. They don’t care about your animals they care about your money.

I’ve been coming here for years and always appreciated the care, especially with Dr. Michelle Donovue, who was wonderful. Unfortunately, my recent experience with Dr. Mohamed Elhadary was extremely disappointing. I brought my dog in because he’s been biting his paw, yet I had to specifically ask the doctor to evaluate it, which was the primary concern. On top of that, he administered an injection without informing me beforehand.

The overall atmosphere of the clinic has declined significantly. The front desk staff were rude and unprofessional, which only added to my frustration. The only positive was Jordan, the technician manager, who did her best to make the situation better, and I truly appreciate her effort.

That said, the level of care and professionalism has declined so much that I no longer feel comfortable bringing my pet here.:(
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Great place with caring staff

This location is the absolute worst. The wait time is ridiculous every time. The only reason i use this practice is for Dr Maleleo and I try to see him as often as possible at the forest avenue office - which is always a great experience. The distance is just hard being on the other side of the island.  9 times out of 10 when i have an appt they always call me with an issue and need to change it. Again the forest avenue location never does this.
absolutely horrible, do not know any information for traveling with pet, and want you to the research even though you’re paying them.
Thanks so much for the review, Arturo!

I would give 10 stars if I could! As a new client here, I am so impressed  with Pleasant Plains Animal Hospital, the entire staff from the front desk to the Doctors, and Technicians are simply Amazing. The care and concern they showed for my Cat as well as myself speaks volumes.
Dr. Meleleo  is Brilliant! Special thanks to all those involved  in the Surgical and Recovery Departments.
As a Multi-Cat  household, I will be happy bringing all of my cats here.
They are competent, caring professionals. The facility is immaculate, offering a welcoming and comfortable Reception area, as well as ample parking.  Open 7 days a week! I highly recommend Pleasant Plains Animal Hospital to everyone who has pets.
I thank each of you again,
Carol LaPeruta
I brought my  dachshund here and they were always so great with him , and at the end these people were so courteous and kind and warm .
Care and clean

We found 2 kittens,we named Morris and Blackie, on our daily walks very frightened we would feed them as it got colder we got to rescue only one. We brought Morris home called Pleasant Plains Animal hospital got an appointment right away where we found out Morris is more a Maris. Dr. Meleleo and staff at both locations are attentive, respectful and very caring. They call to follow up on every visit. Morris is very temperamental so we were very worried on how we would get care for her as she does not like to be touched and easily frightened. We are very happy and comfortable with her care here. Thank you Dr. Meleleo and staff.🙂

I have been bringing my dogs there since 2015, and they were always pricey but cared and actually followed up with their overpriced testing. This time around, 9 years later, they had me do a very expensive double cavity ultra sound. I waited very long for results that would require surgery if a heart murmur was not present. I never received a call for results after spending over $1000 in testing. I kept calling until I got the vet on the phone and she just said he didn’t have a heart murmur and needed surgery for bladder stones and a small growth in his mouth. Last week I had his records transferred to All Saints Animal Hospital for a sudden anal gland rupture and sure enough the heart murmur was listed on his records they never sent me. They were going to do a $5000 surgery that would’ve ultimately killed my dog because he cannot be sedated due to his heart murmur. This practice only cares about money, even at the expense of killing their patients. They also wanted to pull 20 teeth at $175 a tooth. My dog only has 10 teeth left, as elderly dogs and people start losing teeth naturally in old age. If you want to spend a lot of money for vets that don’t care and won’t follow up with you and will possibly kill your dog for a quick buck. By all means use this vet. Not sure what happened since 2020 but that’s when this place changed for the worse. Hopefully one day they are shut down forever. I will be filing a formal complaint. Predatory unethical practices all around.

Thanks so much for the review, Michael!
Thank you for your review!

Dr. Nasar is THE BEST. My cat is an anxious cat. Dr. Nasar did her best to keep my cat calm. We came early in the morning for our appointment and we were in and out. They did test quickly and were compassionate
Thank you for your review, Vinnie!
We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us this review, Vincent!
Awesome staff Dr Deaf is a gem, she has helped my yorkipoo and his allergies tremendously
Thank you for your review!
Great service with Friendly staff! 10/10

Visiting from another state and my dog’s prescription food is late on delivery by a day from our home town vet. I was denied the ability to purchase 2 cans of food because my dog is not their patient. They had zero desire to help even though I have an active prescription from our home town vet.
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!

My Chewbacca is a new client/ patient! The staff is so nice and caring!! My pup had eye, ear and skin allergies! Doctor Luongo is amazing 😻! So knowledgeable and kind! So totally happy with our experience there! Thank you guys ! …

I brought my cat in last Tuesday.  He was limping and obviously in pain.  $935.00 later blood panel and x-rays, no answers on day 5.  I called and asked for some pain meds.  I called three times that day and they would nor dispense  anything for him.  I am thoroughly disgusted and disappointed with them.  WHERE IS THEIR COMPASSION
